_comment: Per-category PASSED counts (pass + flaky) of the previous accepted release gate. The gate fails a category whose passed count is below GATE_DROP_THRESHOLD (default 70 percent) of its value here, unless it was started with --allow-count-drop "<reason>". Refresh from "baseline_candidate" of a GREEN gate report after each release. Only tier L has a baseline; S and M print a warning (the count-drop check is not applied). A diff-selection gate never checks the ratio (it prints 'selection'), so these values only matter for a full tier-L run (nightly, --full).
source: GATEFIX-POST2250-297 (2026-10-28): values NOT refreshed. The green 2.25.0 gate (release/2250 @ 1e8a3feb1) is a diff-selection run (reduced: preview 50 of 736 spec files, backend 77 of 762), its baseline_candidate (preview 1084, backend 1611, dev 13, pixel 10, fixture 0) is a selection count, and applying it would turn the 70 percent drop check into noise. Only a green FULL tier-L run may replace these values. The last full run (release/2250 @ 8d6cde719, 2026-10-28 01:24) was red (18 preview failures, 3 pixel; the selection run on 1e8a3feb1 followed the fixes): its candidate was preview 15336, dev 978, pixel 130 (the visual step left out), fixture 15, backend 18118, which fits the estimates below. GATELANES-297 (2026-10-27), on top of GATEAUDIT-297 below: pixel 218 -> 175 (the 43 tesla / crystal per-skin pixel cases that ran on desktop + mobile are now structural smoke tests: 48 listed minus 5 the specs skip at run time); preview 14935 -> 14971 (+43 smoke cases, -4 uxfix-rtl and about -3 of the 300-camera case moved to the timing lane); dev 937 -> 935 (the two 3D timing tests moved to the timing lane); backend unchanged (LAT1 idle moved to the lane, its clock-free half added; the door slot-recovery half is new and lane-only); the 12 archived owner-round specs only ever skipped in a gate. Estimates; the next green full tier-L run's baseline_candidate replaces them. A release gate with the visual step leaves visual-matrix out of pixel (about 135 expected), still above 70 percent of 175. GATEAUDIT-297 (2026-10-27):the last FULL tier-L run is the nightly on main @ 011c97d4d (2.23.1, 2026-10-27 02:00): baseline_candidate preview 15086, dev 1038, pixel 221, fixture 15, backend 17611. Adjusted for what changed after it: the bubble freeze (2.23.2) skips 151 preview and 101 dev tests that passed there (whole-file skips + every test titled with the bubble skin); pixel +25 (the visual-matrix baselines re-taken here now pass), -8 (the evidence-design-foundation zero-pixel duplicates removed here), about -20 (bubble pixel cases now skipped). The values are therefore an estimate within a few percent, far inside the 70 percent threshold; replace them with the baseline_candidate of the first green full tier-L run that contains this branch. The previous values (integ/293-rel @ b3788047, 2026-10-20: preview 11935, dev 936, pixel 188, backend 12106) were a week and about 3000 preview / 5500 backend tests behind.
